title: Coherence of already normalized stage and arrow families
statement: Given any family of AdjointDatum for each stage and compactification, and Change for every stage arrow and compactification, there exists a unique family of normalized RefinementDatum. The given projections and mates satisfy scalar composition and identity equations and the two refinement squares. This does not construct adjunctions or coefficient comparisons: they are input families [def-pur-finite-coefficient-adjoint-data].

source.place: Parent lem-pur-finite-coefficient-adjoint-comparisons, numbered proof steps; general separated finite-type extension via ordinary-etale closed support as recorded there.

proof.text: The projection cocycle, tensor associators and open balancing give identity, composite and mixed coefficient equalities for $q$; the refinement square is the cited site/coefficient square. Mate pasting gives those for $b$: both transposes are $T_{A,C}\epsilon_A q_{A,C}^{-1}$. The counit equation defines $b$. The transpose of $G_B(q_K)b_{F_AK}T\eta_{A,K}$ is $q_K(T\epsilon_A)(TF_A\eta_A)q_K^{-1}=1$ by naturality and the triangle identity, proving the unit equation. Step 1 gives the claimed cofinal subsystem.

source.place: Agent-written ordinary-etale extraction of the locality/chart argument

proof.text: Projection normalization and the site/coefficient cocycle prove projection composition, identity and refinement. Construct refinement by the canonical lower compactification comparison and its adjoint conjugate. Transpose the two sides of each mate equation: counit normalization reduces them to the corresponding projection equation, so injectivity proves equality. Witness normalization uniquely fixes the lower refinement and the normalized counit fixes the upper refinement; function extensionality and proof irrelevance give uniqueness of the family.
